Cadence

Twenty bolder directions

Each direction is applied to two screens: the public landing page and the signed-in timesheet. Every one uses the same real copy, the published price, and one sample week, so you are comparing design and nothing else.

Ten build from the new blue logo and ten turn up today’s green. Open any thumbnail to see the full page; it works at phone width too. Shortlist the ones worth pursuing, then copy your picks and send them back.

  1. Today

    Current design

    What ships now, for comparison. Its timesheet was captured on the week of October 19 with test data.
